**Counting rule:** `--max-results N` counts only four event types — **`match`, `occurrence`, `file`, `count`** (`src/batch.zig:77-83`, `src/batch.zig:7-8`; CLI help `src/main.zig:93-96`).

**Context lines do not count.** `context` and `passthru` accompany results but never increment the counter (`src/batch.zig:8`). The unit test feeds match+context+match+match with `--max-results 1` and asserts `returned == 1`, `omitted == 2` (`src/batch.zig:568-579`). Verified live: `--json -C1 --max-results 2` emitted 2 matches plus 3 context lines, yet reported `"returned":2,"omitted":1`.

Also not counted:
- control events `query_end`/`summary`, always emitted (`src/batch.zig:15-16`);
- `provenance`, which still weighs on `--max-output-tokens` (`GUIA.md:838-840`).

Compact mode (`--json=compact`) applies the same rule via row tag: only tags starting `c` (context) or `p` (passthru) are excluded (`src/batch.zig:269`; tags `src/out_json.zig:233-240`).

The budget covers the whole call, and truncation never stops the scan — `omitted` keeps counting (`src/main.zig:94-95`, `src/batch.zig:13-14`).
